rationale: This revision resolves the prior defect: answer_attributes is now limited to messages.message_text, matching exactly what the prompt requests ('pull up the text of that message'), with no unrequested supplemental field smuggled into the obligation. The core design remains sound: two workspace members named 'Robert' (Robert Walsh in #engineering, Robert Chen in #core-infra per channel_members) each tada-react to a distinct message, creating a genuine underspecified referent with no delegated tie-breaking authority in the prompt — correctly modeled via candidate_role_sets and selection 'one'. The route (MESSAGE→REACTION→USER→CONVERSATION_MEMBERSHIP→CONVERSATION→WORKSPACE) is exercised without shortcuts, and the access plan uses only documented, realistic calls (conversations.history on channels the bot belongs to per channel_members, reactions.get, users.info for display-name confirmation) without relying on unavailable workspace-name lookups or hidden timestamp fields. The negatives are now each paired with an explicit supporting reaction record (walsh_thumbsup_reaction, lukas_tada_reaction), cleanly isolating the two dimensions of exclusion (wrong emoji from the matching reactor; correct emoji from a non-matching reactor) without leaking the answer. Planned new messages/reactions not yet in the base seed are acceptable at this design stage. The prompt is short, natural, and the two-Robert ambiguity gives the case a meaningful, non-trivial evaluation target.
